data_description.model_variants: Trains four variants every week (standard, with extra weather inputs, with a short memory, both) and runs the one that is clearly best for this plant. Off: standard only, training is faster.

sensors.title: Production sensors
sensors.description:
Select the sensors that measure what the **panels** produce. Several sensors are added up.

- Inverter with battery (hybrid): don't use the inverter's AC power, it includes battery discharge. Use the panels' DC production or an energy meter integrated from it.
- Smart plug whose meter resets after a restart: prefer its power sensor.

data_description.limit_w: If production is capped (e.g. 600 W balcony plant or an export limit). The forecast then never goes above it.

confirm_negative.title: Is this the right sensor?
confirm_negative.description:
{entity_id} went down to {lowest} W in the last 30 days. Panels never produce negative power – this is typical for an inverter's AC output with a battery charging from the grid. The forecast learns from this sensor, so the result may be wrong.

Continue anyway, or go back and choose the panels' production sensor.

error.unsupported_unit: The sensor must measure power (W, kW) or energy (Wh, kWh).
error.no_statistics: The sensor has no long-term statistics (state_class is missing).
error.wrong_kind: The sensor does not match the chosen measurement (power or energy).
